issues.what: In -a the cyclone is an open spiral of thin, broken cumulus bands with dark sea showing between them and a small, soft eye. In -b it is a dense, bright, nearly solid overcast disc with a large, hard black eye, and it reads as a heavier, different storm
issues.fix: open it back into thin, separate bands with dark ocean between them, take the brightness down and shrink and soften the eye

issues.where: open ocean, especially the left half and the top
issues.what: -a has fine popcorn cumulus and thin wind streaks over a dark navy sea. In -b the cloud is long, smeared, slab-like streaks that look like brush strokes and cover much more of the sea. The extra cloud layers are settled, but this cloud shape and coverage are not
issues.fix: break the slabs into small, scattered cumulus cells and thin wind lines, and let more dark navy sea show through

issues.where: sea and land colour around the pelvis, the legs and the lower right
issues.what: -a has rust-red and olive-ochre sediment plumes trailing east from the pelvis and around both legs, and terracotta flanks on the ribs and skull. In -b these are mostly gone and the land is an even grey-green, so the warm rust palette is lost
issues.fix: bring back the red-brown plume streaming right from the pelvis, the olive and ochre swirls around the legs, and the rust tones on the rib and skull ridges

issues.where: sun glow on the sea, upper right
issues.what: -a has a warm golden sun sheen on the ocean at the right edge. In -b it is a cool grey-white haze under cloud, so the light direction and its warmth are weaker
issues.fix: warm the glow back to gold and let it brighten the open sea surface rather than the cloud haze

issues.where: the upper leg and foot reaching to the upper right
issues.what: In -a the leg runs out to a raised foot near the top-right corner. In -b the limb stops short around x 90% and the foot is lost in haze. This is more than less exact toes: the foot is missing
issues.fix: extend the limb out to the raised foot where -a has it

issues.what: -a has one large, dark crater eye and a blue lagoon. -b shows two crater eyes plus the lagoon
issues.fix: keep a single dominant dark crater eye as in -a

issues.where: the glowing point in the upper ribs
issues.what: In -b the point is a brighter, whiter flare. In -a it is a small, dim orange spark
issues.fix: dim it and warm it to a small orange point

issues.where: space above the limb, top left
issues.what: -b shows faint stars in the black. -a has none
